name: Recover from ineffective edits
when: Repeated pose changes fail to resolve the diagnosed error or alternate between failures.
procedure: Compare recent actions and observations to identify repetition or reversal.
Reconsider the error type, edited object and transformation direction.
Seek missing permitted evidence, then try a different limited correction; restore an earlier pose only if the interface permits it.
verification: The revised action changes the failure pattern rather than repeating it.
failure_lessons: Do not assume every task supports a free undo or independent candidate trials.
adaptation_notes: Original recovery card; hypothetical lessons require future execution validation.
